stage: Definition, software verification and calibration; any unmodified Torah-NT execution requires a separate future frozen protocol.
rule_id: Nested order direction, a-index, b-index, c: (((direction_index*4+a_index)*4+b_index)*24+c).
rule: Read one contiguous Hebrew unit in the declared direction. For its consecutive ranks h_i,h_(i+1), predict Greek rank (a*h_i+b*h_(i+1)+c) modulo 24 with nonnegative remainder. The SAME a,b,c,direction must predict all three passages. No arbitrary letter table, error, skipped source letter, gap crossing, source wrap or Greek reversal.
length_semantics: K predicted Greek letters consume K+1 consecutive Hebrew letters. Source coordinates always refer to the original unreversed unit. At length 32 the score is censored at the cap.
degeneracy: No source/output diversity cutoff and no coprimality restriction. Constant and periodic predictions are included, explicitly reported when selected, and challenged by reference models and synthetic repetition controls; no favorable output pattern is silently removed.
statistic: Largest K in 8..32 for which a single rule admits three matching passage pairs with distinct source group IDs and distinct Greek group IDs. Score zero when no such triple exists. For each rule, this is a bipartite matching of size three after retaining group-pair edges with a literal match of length at least K.
groups: All witnesses of one Hebrew verse share one group; all windows of one Greek verse share one group. Fixed human block groups and synthetic groups are labelled explicitly. Distinct groups need not have independent wording.
complete_search: Index every source prediction window at length eight for all 16 coefficient pairs and both directions, using modulo-24 differences from its first predicted rank. Each Greek start with the same difference sequence determines exactly one intercept c. Extend literally up to 32. For a fixed rule and group pair, retaining the longest match is sufficient because all its shorter prefixes obey the same fixed rule and there is no diversity filter.
ties: For the observation, return the score of EVERY one of the 768 rules, all positive maximizing rule IDs, and one deterministic matching triple per maximizing rule. Within a group-pair edge retain the first encountered longest match; scan order is Greek unit/start then source-index insertion order (direction,a,b,source unit,start). Matching traversal uses ascending group IDs. Do not claim that passage triples or mathematically broader rules are unique.
references: Use both existing models on common-policy Greek tokens: within-unit labelled word permutations and one global bijection of word types within each length. Repeat the complete rule/position/group/length selection in every reference corpus. Inclusive p=(1+reference maxima>=observed)/(B+1).
description_cost: Conditional fixed-width parameter code is 10 bits (1 direction, 2 a-index, 2 b-index, 5 intercept; unused intercept encodings rejected), plus 5 bits for K in 8..32 and six unit/start addresses. Also charge decoder, alphabet ranks, normalization, corpus/selection protocols and any tie selection. Report these costs separately; no absolute Kolmogorov or divine-origin probability claim.
resource_guards: At most 5000000 indexed source prediction starts and 1000000 compatible source-rule/Greek seed pairs per scan. If exceeded, terminate explicitly with no statistical conclusion rather than truncate. All legal starts and formal parameter/start counts are reported, not asserted independent trials.
overlap: Some algebraic forms overlap FAM-001, but its global alignment, wrap and reverse-neighbor conventions differ. Local selection and the broader coefficient set are new tested choices, not independent replication. FAM-003's single-letter injectivity bound does not apply to this two-letter rule.
limitations: This is one finite context-dependent arithmetic grammar, not all short programs, semantic translation, arbitrary variable-length encoding or approximate matching.
registration: Local freeze before this family is implemented or executed; no external preregistration or sealed reserve.
